items.title: Girl 68
items.prompt: A long-haired figure in a dark oversized bomber jacket leans on the iron railing of a city balcony at night, seen from behind, their loose hair lifting in the breeze and one hand holding a half-empty glass bottle that dangles over the edge. They are a soft, blurred silhouette in the foreground against a vivid nocturnal cityscape. Below and beyond, a wide river reflects the warm orange and yellow streetlights in long, rippling streaks, with a small lit tour boat leaving a wake across the water. On the right in the mid-ground stands a grand neoclassical building with a columned facade and a green copper dome, outlined in bright white floodlights. A busy boulevard runs along the waterfront into the distance, with car headlights and red taillights streaking past, a lone cyclist under a lamppost, a red traffic light glowing at the nearest crossing and a yellow-lit tram crossing a bridge further away. A faint drizzle catches the light as tiny glinting specks in the air, and the dark sky holds a low orange haze from the city glow. Low-angle shot across the railing, with the foreground figure and railing softly out of focus while the river, building, traffic and bridge stay crisp and detailed. Raw, grainy 1990s analog color snapshot with warm sodium-vapor tones, slight halation around the lights, visible film grain and no digital sharpening.

items.title: Food 5
items.prompt: A close-up of a glossy black ceramic bowl of ramen on a scratched stainless steel counter at a futuristic night-market food stall, a pair of lacquered red chopsticks lifting a tangle of thick, chewy noodles out of the broth so they rise in a dripping arc into a dense cloud of steam. The rich amber broth glistens with floating droplets of chili oil, topped with slices of seared pork belly with charred edges, a halved soft-boiled egg with a jammy orange yolk, a sheet of nori, a swirl of pink fish cake and a scatter of bright green scallions. The steam curls upward and catches the colored light, refracting the glow of holographic signs and LED billboards along a foggy, rain-slicked market street, where blurred magenta, cyan and electric yellow shapes of a floating holographic koi and stacked unreadable neon signs bleed softly into the mist. Behind the bowl, red plastic stools stand scattered around low tables, a vendor’s gloved hands work over a hissing wok in a burst of orange flame, and a few silhouetted customers in hooded rain jackets sit hunched over their bowls, all softly out of focus. Neon from the street washes the left side of the bowl and noodles in cyan and magenta while a warm bare bulb above the stall lights the broth and toppings in gold, with tiny highlights on every oil droplet. Handheld close-up at counter height with shallow depth of field keeping the noodles, toppings and steam sharp while the billboards dissolve into large soft bokeh. Oversaturated night street-food photograph with soft grain, slight halation around the neon and rich food texture.

items.prompt: 一位年轻女性侧身倚靠在繁茂的绿植与白色花簇旁，她留着柔顺的黑色齐肩发，额前刘海自然垂落，发间点缀着小巧精致的透明发夹，眼神温柔清澈地望向镜头，嘴角微微上扬带着恬静甜美的微笑，脸颊泛着自然柔和的红晕。她身穿一件轻盈飘逸的浅米色碎花连衣裙，裙身上布满淡紫色与绿色交织的小碎花图案，领口和袖口有细腻的荷叶边装饰，裙摆自然垂坠，随着微风轻轻摇曳。她的右臂优雅抬起，手掌张开轻触头顶上方垂落的白色花朵枝条，仿佛在与花枝互动，姿态灵动而充满诗意。一条细长的金色链条斜挎包带从她的左肩延伸至腰侧，在光影中闪烁着温润光泽。前景是她抬手所触的繁密花枝，洁白小花与深绿叶片层层叠叠，部分花瓣被阳光穿透形成半透明质感，叶片边缘因光线照射呈现出柔和的高光。中景是她身体的大部分轮廓以及身旁浓密的蕨类植物与攀爬藤蔓，叶片纹理清晰可见，深浅不一的绿色层次丰富。背景是虚化的庭院石板小径与模糊的木质围栏或建筑结构，地面铺着大小不一的灰色石块，被斑驳的树影覆盖，营造出朦胧而宁静的空间感。整幅画面采用倾斜角度构图，人物头部略微倾斜，视线朝向观者，引导观众目光从她的脸庞、抬起的手臂自然过渡到上方的花枝，再延伸至背景深处。光影氛围温暖柔和，来自侧面偏上的自然光透过树叶间隙洒落，在她发丝、肩颈与裙摆上形成细腻的明暗过渡，阴影部分柔和而不生硬，整体色调偏向低饱和度的暖灰绿色系，带有轻微胶片颗粒感，呈现出一种清新文艺且略带复古滤镜效果的视觉风格，仿佛用一部老旧数码相机在午后拍摄，具有生活化的真实感与情感温度，整个场景散发着青春、自由、自然生长的气息，如同一幅沉浸于春日庭院中的静物肖像画，充满了诗意与温柔的叙事感。

items.title: Girl 68
items.prompt: 这是一张拥有极致细节，超高质量、高清晰的照片，照片中有一位20岁的中国女性，有着迷人的眼睛，真实细腻的肌肤，身穿清新时尚的碎花雪纺上衣，泡泡短袖褶边设计，搭配浅蓝色紧身牛仔裤。她留着黑色长发，头上戴着发箍，右手手腕戴着翡翠手镯。下着大雨，全身湿透，头发贴着皮肤，皮肤上沾满雨水，坐在植物园的长凳上，背后靠着大片盛开的蔷薇花，摆着随机动态的姿势，看着镜头，活泼可爱充满灵气。

items.title: Animals
items.prompt: Two fluffy white ducklings glide serenely across a sun-drenched emerald pool, their soft downy feathers contrasting sharply with the crystalline green water beneath them. The scene is captured from a high-angle perspective, using a 50mm lens at f/4 to create a shallow depth of field that keeps the ducks sharply focused while gently blurring the rippling water surface and distant reflections. Sunlight glints off the water’s surface in sparkling starburst patterns, casting dappled shadows of overhanging trees into the pool below. Each duckling leaves gentle concentric ripples trailing behind as they swim in parallel, their bright orange beaks and dark eyes adding vibrant accents to the composition. The color palette is rich yet natural—vibrant aqua greens, warm golden sunlight, and pure white plumage—evoking a sense of peaceful summer tranquility. The overall atmosphere is idyllic and calming, with every element carefully staged to highlight the innocence and harmony of nature.
